item.title: Hands-On With Gemini Spark: I Gave It Access to My Life and It Friend-Zoned My Boyfriend
item.description: Google's new AI agent combed through my emails, documents, and calendar to plan a birthday party and still didn’t clock the person most important to me.

item.title: We Asked the ‘Future of Truth’ Author to Explain How He Used AI. It Didn’t Go Well
item.description: A book about how AI shapes perceptions of reality came under fire for using AI-generated quotes. Its problems go beyond that.

item.title: The Vatican’s Man Inside Anthropic
item.description: Pope Leo XIV may not be able to disarm AI, but he’s got the attention of the industry.

item.title: Here Comes Ojai, Waymo’s New Chinese-Made Robotaxi
item.description: The pale-blue Ojai vehicles will start picking up members of the public in California and Arizona in the next few weeks.

item.title: New Moms Are Returning to Coding Jobs Radically Reshaped by AI
item.description: New mothers working in software development are staring down an AI-pilled workplace they barely recognize.

item.title: Amazon Thinks the Future of Data Centers Depends on a Technical Problem It Just Solved
item.description: The tech giant says a breakthrough in data center networking has dramatically accelerated the flow of information through its massive cloud infrastructure.

item.title: Illinois Lawmakers Just Passed America’s Strongest AI Safety Bill
item.description: The bill requires companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to have third parties confirm they’re following safety standards. Illinois governor JB Pritzker says he’ll sign it.

item.title: Huawei's ‘Chip Queen’ Throws Down the Gauntlet
item.description: The Chinese company is adapting to the demise of Moore’s Law, which guides chip production. It could complicate US chip dominance.

item.title: Former Google and Apple Researchers Launch a Startup to Build AI’s Missing Feedback Loop
item.description: Trajectory is betting the rapid iteration cycle that supercharged vibe-coding can help all kinds of companies build AI products that learn continuously.

item.title: Pope Leo Schooled the Tech Bros on Tolkien
item.description: The Holy Father referenced The Lord of the Rings in his encyclical about AI—an expert (if unintentional) troll of tech billionaires who keep misinterpreting the series.
